Name: Smooth Swapping
Author: Aapodot
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Smooth Swapping[/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#ff9900][b]⚠️ Early Access Version ⚠️[/b][/color]
This mod is in early development. You may encounter occasional bugs or issues.
Your feedback is welcome! Please report any problems in the [b]Bugs or Post [/b]section.[/center]
[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Smooth Swapping enhances your Stardew Valley experience by adding fluid animations when moving items around. Instead of items instantly teleporting between slots, you'll see them gracefully glide to their destination.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[b]Animated Item Transfers[/b]
[list]
[*]Smooth animations when moving items from your inventory to chests
[*]Smooth animations when moving items from chests to your inventory
[*]Works with all transfer methods the game supports
[/list]
[b]Organize Button Animation[/b]
[list]
[*]When you click the "Organize" button in chests or your inventory, all items animate to their new positions
[*]Watch your messy inventory sort itself with satisfying smooth movements
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod includes full configuration support through Generic Mod Config Menu:
[list]
[*][b]Enable Animation[/b]: Toggle the mod on/off without uninstalling
[*][b]Animation Speed[/b]: Adjust how fast items move (10-500%, default 100%)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 3.0.0 or higher
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
[*]Compatible with most inventory mods
[*]Supports all 12 game languages
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu
[*]Download this mod and extract it to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[*]Run the game through SMAPI
[/list]
